description: This file contains the implementation of the TaxRateService interface, providing business logic for handling TaxRate entities in the shopping platform. It includes methods for retrieving TaxRates by store, country, zone, tax class, and code, as well as deleting TaxRates.

classes.name: TaxRateServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the TaxRateService interface, handling business logic for tax rates including listing by store, country, zone, tax class, and deletion.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of TaxRate objects associated with a specific MerchantStore, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxRate using a specific code for a given MerchantStore.

methods.name: listByCountryZoneAndTaxClass
methods.description: Lists TaxRates filtered by country, zone, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: listByCountryStateProvinceAndTaxClass
methods.description: Lists TaxRates filtered by country, state/province, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified TaxRate after retrieving it by ID.
